About

Curious first, categorised later.

After Class 12 I tried a few kinds of work: about three months in telesales, six months in a grocery store, and private tutoring. Then I moved to the Chandigarh–Zirakpur area for better location and opportunities, carried on with my B.Com, and picked up a guitar.

I cleared my first ACCA paper (BT) and then decided not to continue with the qualification. I'm now weighing US CMA, postgraduate study abroad and CAT/IIM. There's no fixed answer yet, and I'd rather say so than pretend otherwise.

I'm the kind of person who'll happily go from geopolitics to guitar tuning in one conversation. Expect some jokes, some questions and a bit of mystery.
